The decisive mistake was the board representation at Step 3. Boggle_Board_Expert stored the letters in uppercase (`'A'`, `'B'`, ...), but `words_alpha` contains only lowercase words. No board path could ever match a dictionary entry, so every search returned nothing. Step 4 reused the same uppercase board, and the later code changes never touched this. At Step 8, the empty output pointed to a case mismatch, but the agent blamed the DFS and prefix logic instead, so the error went uncorrected.
